ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central region with continuous black pigmentation along the trailing margins. A large, high-contrast black contiguous block is situated on the proximal-left region near the notch. Scattered small-scale black mottle/flecks are distributed across the right lobe, primarily in the distal-upper quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped aperture with a pixel angle of approximately 78 degrees; absolute bounding-box depth is null due to water-line occlusion of the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire continuous trailing edge; peak-to-valley amplitudes range from 2 to 8 pixels against the contrasting water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curve on both trailing edges, tapering to sharp, upward-turned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast clusters of raised, brownish-tan circular formations (barnacles) localized on the outer margins of the left tip and right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear disruptions; two distinct 45-degree diagonal lines on the left lobe and a series of parallel, fine-line diagonal scratches on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal fluke tips; multiple rake-like linear scars on the ventral right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique large-scale black pigment 'island' on the left lobe, disconnected from the primary trailing edge margin.
